name: ANGLE standalone Metal-only runtime
integrityProvenance: SHA256 of received official commit-addressed source archive and exact extracted files; not a claim of separately published upstream release checksums
macGpuFamilyRequirement: MTLGPUFamilyMac2, required by this exact ANGLE source's native Metal availability and ES3 implementation
licenseBoundary: Original ANGLE BSD license, maintained Khronos header notices and complete dependency LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE/README.chromium files are retained with the private stage. Source/DEPS and actual dependency revisions are recorded; no third-party source is patched.
runtimeBoundary: Only standalone libEGL/libGLESv2 dylibs are built and staged; no Electron/Chromium/browser install or execution, no CGL/Vulkan/software fallback, no JS WebGPU, no hidden native canvas windows
qualification: macOS native compilation/link and real Metal pixels require a macOS host. Source pins/build wiring are not a positive runtime or physical-GPU qualification.
